title: Case reading technique — D3
purpose: Failure analysis for Case reading technique: numbers, hidden adjectives, stated versus implied needs, and out-of-scope boundaries.
routing_rationale: Use the D3 lens to keep numbers, hidden adjectives, stated versus implied needs, and out-of-scope boundaries connected to an explicit owner, evidence path, and recovery action.
summary: Extract measurable requirements and watchpoints from a cloud architecture case before choosing services.

nodes.label: Exam Case Brief
nodes.detail: The narrative containing business goals, constraints, and signals.

nodes.label: Measured Facts
nodes.product: Users, RPS, TB, latency, RTO/RPO, budget
nodes.detail: Numbers that turn a vague case into testable requirements.

nodes.label: Requirement Ledger
nodes.detail: A separated list of stated needs and inferred needs.

nodes.label: Watchpoint Register
nodes.detail: Risks hidden behind words such as global, regulated, spiky, or legacy.

nodes.label: GCP Capability Map
nodes.detail: A traceable mapping from each requirement to a cloud capability.

nodes.label: Explicit Out-of-Scope
nodes.detail: Constraints that must not accidentally enter the design.

steps.title: Failure analysis: Requirement Ledger → Watchpoint Register
steps.action: Requirement Ledger challenge assumptions to Watchpoint Register; record evidence for numbers, hidden adjectives, stated versus implied needs, and out-of-scope boundaries.
steps.why_traversal: Inspect the evidence at the failure boundary for Case reading technique by making Watchpoint Register an explicit review boundary.

check.commands: record and verify e3 for Case reading technique

steps.title: Failure analysis: Requirement Ledger → GCP Capability Map
steps.action: Requirement Ledger map to GCP to GCP Capability Map; record evidence for numbers, hidden adjectives, stated versus implied needs, and out-of-scope boundaries.
steps.why_traversal: Inspect the evidence at the failure boundary for Case reading technique by making GCP Capability Map an explicit review boundary.

check.commands: record and verify e4 for Case reading technique

steps.title: Failure analysis: Exam Case Brief → Explicit Out-of-Scope
steps.action: Exam Case Brief mark exclusions to Explicit Out-of-Scope; record evidence for numbers, hidden adjectives, stated versus implied needs, and out-of-scope boundaries.
steps.why_traversal: Inspect the evidence at the failure boundary for Case reading technique by making Explicit Out-of-Scope an explicit review boundary.

check.commands: record and verify e5 for Case reading technique

scenarios.label: A number is missed
scenarios.root_cause: A scale, latency, budget, or recovery figure is not captured.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Case reading technique path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Measured Facts and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Re-read the case and add the value to the requirement ledger.

check.command: review d3 evidence for Measured Facts

scenarios.label: A hidden constraint is ignored
scenarios.root_cause: An adjective conceals regulatory, geographic, or operational risk.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Case reading technique path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Watchpoint Register and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Turn the adjective into an explicit question and review it.

check.command: review d3 evidence for Watchpoint Register

scenarios.label: A service choice has no requirement
scenarios.root_cause: The proposed capability cannot be traced back to a case requirement.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Case reading technique path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of GCP Capability Map and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Reject the orphan choice or document the missing requirement.

check.command: review d3 evidence for GCP Capability Map
